title: Strata Source-Free Session Bundle Manifest v1
description: The manifest.json contract for the bounded Strata POC session bundle. The adjacent journal.ndjson is validated by the runtime against journal_sha256 and journal_event_count.

workspace.description: Opaque JSON workspace state. Its interpretation belongs to the owning workbench, not this bundle contract.

journal_sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the exact journal.ndjson bytes.

sourceFingerprint.description: Identity metadata only. It deliberately excludes a source path, URL, bookmark, and source bytes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the external source bytes.
